title: ODP Brand Transfer Data Contract — Draft v0.1.0
description: Draft schema for brand-to-brand customer transfer observations. This is a Phase A engineering preparation artefact — statistical definitions, thresholds, and source bindings require data-owner confirmation before any production use. This schema replaces the current synthetic CROSS JOIN mock (brand_transfer_view.sql) which hardcodes transfer_ratio = 0.15 and is unsuitable for production scoring.

contract_version.description: Schema contract version. Increment on breaking changes.

observation_id.description: Unique identifier for this transfer observation record.

tenant_id.description: Tenant discriminator for multi-tenant isolation. Required in production; may be omitted in single-tenant test fixtures.

source_brand_id.description: Brand losing customer share. Must reference core.brands.brand_id.

target_brand_id.description: Brand gaining customer share. Must reference core.brands.brand_id. Must differ from source_brand_id.

observation_period.description: Time window over which the transfer was observed or aggregated.

start.description: Inclusive start date of observation window (ISO 8601).

end.description: Inclusive end date of observation window (ISO 8601).

granularity.description: Temporal granularity of the underlying aggregation.

geo_cell_id.description: H3 cell index or trade-area polygon ID defining the observation boundary.

location_type.description: Location classification for the trade area.

store_context.description: Store-level context, if the observation is store-scoped rather than area-scoped.

store_format_code.description: Target store format code (e.g. ODAY_G2, G3_COMPACT, FLAGSHIP).

store_age_bucket.description: Cohort bucket by store operating age.

transfer_ratio.description: Fraction of source-brand customers observed transferring to the target brand within the observation period. MUST be derived from real data — hardcoded constants (e.g. 0.15) are forbidden in production.

transfer_volume.description: Absolute count of transferred customers/transactions. Null when only ratio is available.

sample_size.description: Number of observations underlying the ratio calculation. Null invalidates confidence.

confidence.description: Statistical confidence of the transfer_ratio estimate. Must be computed from sample_size and variance — never hardcoded to 1.0. Null when sample_size is null or insufficient.

measurement_method.description: Method used to measure or estimate the transfer ratio.

data_quality.description: Quality and freshness metadata for the observation.

data_quality_score.description: Composite quality score derived from sample coverage, recency, and method reliability. Must NOT be hardcoded to 1.0.

freshness_days.description: Days since the observation period end. Used for staleness gating.

staleness_threshold_days.description: Maximum acceptable freshness_days before the observation is considered stale.

is_training_eligible.description: Whether this observation may be used for model training.

is_scoring_eligible.description: Whether this observation may be used in live scoring.

source_reference.description: Canonical identifier for the upstream data source (e.g. provider contract ID, dataset version, API endpoint).

source_sha.description: SHA-256 hash of the source data file or API response, if available.

ingested_at.description: UTC timestamp when the data was ingested into the platform.

pipeline_run_id.description: Identifier of the ETL/ingestion pipeline run.
